title: The Bench Dried with a Cloth
youtube_title: The Bench Dried with a Cloth | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A small useful favor can be louder than a big speech.
summary: At a market lane of baskets, jars, and flower pots, a damp bench that needed a dry cloth is awkward for one person. Cosima notices Grandma Nia struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
